question: The most widespread forests in India are of what type?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Tropical Deciduous Forests'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most widespread forests in india is Tropical Deciduous Forests.
 
• This forests are called Moonson Forest.
 
• 
 
There are two types of Deciduous Forests: Moist Deciduous Forests - Mixture of Trees and Grasses ; 2. Dry Deciduous Forests

 
 
• 
 
As the name goes, tropical deciduous forests are found along the Equator belt between the tropic of Cancer and tropic of Capricorn.
